Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene

Class Scene

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.Scene
public final class Scene extends Object
A scene with its own clock, object namespace, and incoming transition.

Owns a root group, camera, optional theme and backdrop, and transition configuration. Validation checks unique IDs, event bounds, plot parents, graph endpoints and tree topology before rendering.
